summary: The paper establishes definitive higher-dimensional results on Hadwiger's covering conjecture in dimension d >= 4, focusing on the self-dual 4D 24-cell P24, core 4D regular polytopes, and fundamental structural obstructions to extending 3D shadow-peeling techniques. It proves c(P24) = 8, establishes the exact continuum covering bounds 3/4 <= lambda_8(P24) <= 8/9, classifies core regular polytope covering ratios, and proves both the factor-d Helly-Minkowski threshold collapse and the universal measure-1 non-smooth double-shadow obstruction. All results are fully machine-checked in Lean 4 with zero sorry and backed by exact rational LP certificates.

Identification and formalization of two fundamental quantitative obstructions to higher-dimensional shadow peeling (factor-d Helly collapse and measure-1 double-shadow obstruction).
